title: Certify the complete mixed-group common-axis centre cost ceiling (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This source-bound paid-invoice proof closes a coordinated retagging grammar left open by #4867: every subset of all 184 newly variable retained640 centre contacts may choose its old chart or its image under one common nonzero transvection axis, simultaneously across nine different original-chart groups. It is a supporting ceiling, with no new κ or physical supplier claim.

The actual graph has 176 empty-chart contacts, eight distinct singleton original-chart groups, 256 internal rank-zero edges and eight rank-eight edges. Every rank-eight edge has a singleton endpoint of internal degree one. Exact conditional leaf elimination removes potentially negative binary interactions, leaving an integer s-t cut over the 176 empty-chart contacts. All 640 endpoints, native maps, operations and 408 helper targets stay fixed; all incident transitions remain paid, and no centre output receives independent credit.

The nine original charts have common intersection `{0}`, so the sweep literally covers all 262,143 nonzero ambient axes. They induce 419 complete rank-energy configurations. All 3,771 exact prefix-tariff cuts have optimum zero. Hence every candidate has `S_j = sum_r delta_r min(r,j) >= 0` for `j=1,...,9`; the written summation-by-parts argument proves nonnegative paid-moment change for every `0<theta<1`. The rounded moment diagnostic is not a premise of that proof. Strict loss and uniqueness are not claimed.

The full old paid profile is `{1:2201,2:412,3:510,4:127,5:40,8:8}`, with fixed helper targets `{4:28,7:7,8:47,9:326}`. Independent/mixed axes, changed operations or changed caller demand are outside scope. Native phase/word construction, all 640 primal/raw-dual checks, owned caller, compiler/precision and outer admission remain additional obligations; no profitable invoice exists in this grammar to justify launching them. Primary κ research continues through a different operation/budget gate.

## Task and overlap

Canonical base and refreshed main: `624de9dc66858af0945e5f8a0942488d62280d43`. Task `complex-rank-shape-decoder`, priority revision7, **scope changed** from a proposed rank-shape construction to this exact finite paid-invoice ceiling. TASK.json retains the full originating card and explains the change. The concrete bounded object is the retained640 centre contact graph with all 184 binary choices and all 262143 common axes; no seeds or random restarts are used.

- #4867 at `5e4cce12a9851fbb46cd7c32cc8177e983771539` supplies the retained640 graph, source bytes and prior single/pair/single-original-group ceiling. This adds simultaneous choices across different original groups through an exact leaf reduction.
- Nick Petalas #4864 at `eac6ce76eeabdd027b6cb5cbedd0e006e784bfce` supplies the general tuple/cycle-constrained neighborhood geometry. It is citation-only here, not imported, executed or re-proved. The present graph has identity internal maps and uses literal ambient-axis enumeration; its actual boundary invoice is the new application.
- David Ganz / Dugongue #4841 at `6debdcdac8fe1c87958f8cd42ccb7db73c0a0eef` supplies the inherited native chart and exact local rank-change setting.

SOURCES.json pins runtime copies at scientific ancestor `159eb73dd70ccdb03af6f61435135c026cf9886a`, with separate exact PR4867 source-provenance rows. A tree-preserving provenance merge retains #4867 history for cold source checks. No predecessor package or selected frontier file changes. No public prospective CLAIM was posted before the short sweep finished; the publication is an honest DONE finding.

## Validation

On Ubuntu, Python3.12, C++20 `g++`, with `-O3 -Wall -Wextra -Werror`:

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/sol1337-global-centre-cut/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/sol1337-global-centre-cut/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/sol1337-global-centre-cut
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/sol1337-global-centre-cut --check-source-history
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py export --package research/sol1337-global-centre-cut --ref 673b1f38379ee88513dfbe2d828845afa7c2f9ec --output /tmp/sol1337-global-centre-cut-review.tar
python3 -B scripts/export_research_package.py check /tmp/sol1337-global-centre-cut-review.tar
```

Expected direct output: `PASS_GLOBAL_CENTRE_CUT axes=262143 configurations=419 exact_prefix_cuts=3771 controls=3`. Registered ordinary and optimized commands, exact committed-byte/source-history preflight, official 20-file committed export/integrity and Git-free optimized direct replay all pass locally. The source-history check includes canonical base, scientific 159eb73dd and exact 4867head. Package-local attributes preserve authenticated predecessor CRLF bytes.

Every retained rank-energy configuration is independently checked by binary row elimination. Each cut checks conserved feasible flow, equal attaining cut capacity and a lifted original184-variable rank-histogram invoice. Negative sign, nonidentity internal map and changed old invoice controls reject. A separate read-only agent found no correctness issue and independently priced180 literal mixed-group assignments over 36 axes and exhaustively compared256 leaf assignments in 108 held-core/tariff cases. The parent separately read the proof and reran optimized warning-strict verification.

These finite computations certify the stated source-specific optimization; the written identity supplies the all-theta implication. Hosted CI is pending publication; independent human and formal proof-kernel acceptance are unclaimed. No historical/native/Lean/Docker/selected-frontier suite was launched.

## Open next questions

The package README and TASK.json retain the smallest changed-mechanism question: declare an independent/mixed-axis replacement, changed source operation or actual changed caller demand, and first write its complete chronological boundary and optimistic paid bill. A profitable paid-profile candidate plus fully charged completion is required before native/compiler expansion. Another common-axis seed or subset cannot reopen this complete grammar. No further construction or κ claim is part of this PR.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The singleton-leaf topology reduced an apparently signed binary model to an exact cut. Complete rank-configuration deduplication made the full 262143-axis domain and all nine prefix tariffs finish in a few seconds, avoiding a large seed campaign. Registration required pinning local retained copies and predecessor provenance separately because the standard source-pin syntax preserves identical row/pin paths. The source-history merge makes that distinction cold-checkable.


## Merge danger

Door: two-way. Blast radius: one isolated registered research package with a tree-preserving provenance merge. No predecessor files, production helper or selected record changes.
